keeper_transition_rule: All mandatory tasks must pass after relevant fixes and repeat review; automated prework, build, contact, material, and geometry checks cannot independently assign keeper status.

mandatory_tasks.requirement: Record exact catalogue archetype and variant ids plus authoritative image paths, bytes, and SHA-256 hashes.
mandatory_tasks.hard_failure: Missing provenance, text-only invented reference, mixed sibling variants, or unavailable authoritative source image.

mandatory_tasks.requirement: Compare the locked reference to the archetype images for footprint, massing, floor count, proportions, roof topology, entrance, opening rhythm, material zones, and identity details.
mandatory_tasks.hard_failure: Reference redesign or drift from the authoritative archetype.

mandatory_tasks.requirement: Review front, corner, aerial, side, rear-side, facade-close, and glass-close renders; inspect every exterior and courtyard volume, roof junction, opening, projection, support, contact, circulation void, and service elevation.
mandatory_tasks.hard_failure: Unfinished, floating, unsupported, hidden, intersecting, generic-carrier, or topologically incorrect geometry.

mandatory_tasks.requirement: Verify structural grammar, program, hierarchy, public entrance, roofline, material character, glazing system, and distinctive silhouette against both source tiers.
mandatory_tasks.hard_failure: The model is detailed but represents a different architectural identity or program.

mandatory_tasks.requirement: Record every discrepancy, apply the relevant reference, geometry, architectural, material, and glazing fixes, and regenerate the complete locked review set.
mandatory_tasks.hard_failure: Any blocker remains open or only the hero view was corrected.

mandatory_tasks.requirement: Repeat the complete three-way review against the corrected on-disk GLB and record zero unresolved blockers.
mandatory_tasks.hard_failure: Fixes were not re-rendered and independently re-reviewed.

mandatory_tasks.requirement: A reviewer other than the builder records the decision, evidence paths, review date, and zero unresolved blockers.
mandatory_tasks.hard_failure: Builder self-approval, inferred approval, or promotion from automated checks.
